verses.text: Because of this, is the gospel preached to them who are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live in the spirit according to the will of God.
And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves; for charity preventeth a multitude of sins.

title: JST, 1 Peter 4:6. Compare 1 Peter 4:6 The gospel is preached to those who are dead.
